summary: The agent failed because it wrote a custom script for logistics reliability analysis instead of using a bundled skill. The output had wrong key names (t_stat vs trend_t_stat, wilson_95_ci_lower_pct vs wilson_ci_lower_pct), rounded numeric values, missing trend_p_value fields, and extra non-schema keys (variance_diagnostic, action_plan). This is the same multi-sheet Excel statistical analysis pattern as healthcare-quality-analysis and devops-pipeline-analysis, but for logistics domain. Created a new logistics-reliability-analysis skill with bundled script, schema reference, and brief template following the proven pattern.
